masters_master_id: Unique Discogs identifier for the master release.
masters_master_main_release: Discogs release ID of the specific pressing chosen as this master's primary/representative release.
masters_master_title: Title of the master release (the abstract work, independent of any specific pressing).
masters_master_year: Year the work was originally released, as recorded on the master.
masters_master_data_quality: Discogs community data-quality flag for this entry (e.g. Correct, Needs Vote, Needs Major Changes).
master_genres_genre: Broad genre tag(s) assigned to the master (e.g. Electronic, Rock, Jazz). A JSON array when multiple exist.
master_styles_style: More specific style tag(s) within the genre (e.g. Techno, House, Ambient). A JSON array when multiple exist.
artists_artist_id: Discogs ID of an artist credited on the master.
artists_artist_name: Name of an artist credited on the master.
artists_artist_anv: Artist Name Variation: how the artist is credited on this specific master, if different from their canonical artists_artist_name.
artists_artist_join: Join phrase connecting this artist credit to the next one (e.g. "&", "Featuring", "vs.") when a master has multiple credited artists.
masters_master_notes: Free-text notes about the master release.
master_videos_video_src: Source URL of an embedded video associated with the master (e.g. an official YouTube link).
master_videos_video_duration: Duration in seconds of the video at master_videos_video_src.
master_videos_video_embed: Whether the video player should be embedded ("true"/"false").
videos_video_description: Description text of an embedded video.
